description: Build one option structure from a user-supplied chain and return its opaque payoff PNG with permanent source and risk warnings.
name: option_strategy_from_snapshot

PlotImage.description:
One PNG carried inside the structured result for the plot app.

The image content blocks still carry the same bytes for clients that
show them directly. The app resource reads this copy, because a host
hands an app the structured content and not the content blocks.
PlotImage.title: PlotImage

outputSchema.description: Structured metadata returned with an inline plot result.

captured_at.description: Snapshot or fixture timestamp, when available.
captured_at.title: Captured At

data_mode.description: Whether the figures are synthetic or user supplied.
data_mode.title: Data Mode

data_source.description: Named source used for the figures.
data_source.title: Data Source

expiry_note.description: Set when the requested expiry is not the one the figures are for.
expiry_note.title: Expiry Note

images.description: The returned images, for the inline plot app.
images.title: Images

plot_types.description: Plot names in the same order as the image content.
plot_types.title: Plot Types

strategy.description: Requested strategy for a payoff plot, when applicable.
strategy.title: Strategy

strategy_records.description: Exact plotted engine records. Use these for tables; do not infer values from images.
strategy_records.title: Strategy Records

outputSchema.title: PlotResult
